bio.text: Jessica Scarcella-Spanton has represented New York State Senate District 23 since taking office on January 1, 2023, succeeding Diane Savino.
Ballotpedia lists Scarcella-Spanton as the Democratic and Affordable & Safe Party candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Scarcella-Spanton was born in and lives in Staten Island, and previously worked as a legislative director in the New York State Assembly and as director of operations for Sen. Savino.
